# Pixel Invoice Builder

A simple offline invoice builder with line items, tax rate, and totals.

## Features
- Add/remove line items with description, quantity, and unit price
- Line totals, subtotal, tax, and grand total calculated automatically
- Tax rate input in percent
- All amounts displayed to two decimals

## Usage
Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or network required.

## Files
- `index.html` – markup
- `styles.css` – styling
- `script.js` – logic
